'''Bouillon''' ({{langx|ht|'''bouyon'''}}; {{IPAc-en|ˈ|b|uː|j|ɒ|n}}) is a [[Haiti]]an [[soup]].<ref>[https://books.google.com/books?id=ZZEeyKrytcwC&dq=Bouillon+soup%2C+haiti&pg=PA102 Food Culture In The Caribbean – Lynn Marie Houston – Google Books<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> This name comes from the French verb ''bouillir'', meaning to ''boil''. It is made with sliced [[meat]], [[potato]]es, sliced [[Plantain (cooking)|plantain]]s, [[Yam (vegetable)|yam]], [[spinach]], [[watercress]], [[cabbage]], and [[celery]] (other ingredient variations exist), and cooked as a mildly thick soup.
